biotools.summary: COCOA-Tree is a Python library for performing coevolutionary analysis of protein sequences, enabling visualization and comparison of results onto phylogenetic trees. It aids in understanding the evolutionary origins of functional patterns like protein sectors and specificity-determining positions.
